_meta.title: SLATE vehicle research: real published figures
_meta.rules: Every figure carries a source URL, the period it applies to and sourceType (primary = manufacturer, government, regulator, central bank, or official registration body SMMT/SIMI; secondary = press, analyst, industry data vendor). Unconfirmable figures are null and listed in 'uncertain'. No estimates are presented as published. Currencies are in their own units.

finIns.rule: Every non-null value was read from the cited page or document. Nulls are unconfirmed and listed in 'uncertain'. No estimates are presented as published figures.

vehicletrendsMedianRetentionAll.description: Median used-listing price / MSRP by vehicle age, all powertrains, all vehicle types (US). Source bins are 3-month bins; the bin whose midpoint follows each whole year is reported with its exact midpoint. Not interpolated.
vehicletrendsMedianRetentionAll.period: US listings (marketcheck.com); the package's related price series cover listing years 2018-2025; exact depreciation window not stated
vehicletrendsMedianRetentionAll.note: Academic dataset by John Paul Helveston (vehicletrends.us, GWU); rr defined as price/MSRP per https://pkg.vehicletrends.us/articles/datasets. Listing (asking) prices against MSRP, so year-1 retention (0.94) is far higher than trade-in or transaction curves.

vehicletrendsMedianRetentionGasoline.note: powertrain Gasoline, vehicle_type All, median. Same bins as the All series (13.5, 25.5 ... 121.5 months).

vehicletrendsMedianRetentionBEV.note: powertrain 'Battery Electric (BEV)', vehicle_type All, median. Same bins.

vehicletrendsAnnualRateGasolineCar.unit: annual depreciation rate, 1-exp(b) from log-linear fit of retention on age
vehicletrendsAnnualRateGasolineCar.note: Other rows: Gasoline CUV 0.0819, Gasoline SUV 0.0631, Gasoline Pickup 0.0487, Gasoline Minivan 0.0806, BEV Car 0.1023, BEV CUV 0.1040, HEV Car 0.0718.

iSeeCarsAllCars.note: Retained share is 100 minus these; iSeeCars publishes the loss only. No 1-year figure.

iSeeCars5Year2026.note: By type: trucks 34.2, hybrids 35.4, SUVs 44.9, EVs 57.2.

registrationFeeByWeight.period: schedule effective 2009-09-01; form MV-202 (4/23), current as fetched 2026-09-29
registrationFeeByWeight.note: Two-year fees by vehicle weight in pounds. Form note: the minimum two-year fee for a vehicle with 6 or more cylinders, or for an electric vehicle, is $32.50.

plateFee.note: DMV page: $12.50 for a vehicle with one plate. Plate transfer fee $10.00.

nycVehicleUseTax.note: Bronx, Kings, New York, Queens, Richmond. Charged on original and renewal registrations.

mctdSupplementalRegistrationFee.note: Applies in the 12 MCTD counties: New York, Bronx, Kings, Queens, Richmond, Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk, Westchester.

salesTaxRate.note: Dealer sales: full trade-in credit. Private sales: tax on the higher of NADA average trade-in value or bill-of-sale price.

luxurySalesTaxRate.unit: fraction of the ENTIRE purchase price
luxurySalesTaxRate.note: Applies to motor vehicles with a sales price over $50,000; the 7.75% applies to the whole price, not just the excess (CT DMV/DRS SN 2011-10).

registrationFeePassenger.note: DMV fee page lists $120 but did not state the term in the extracted text; the three-year term is from CGS 14-49 ('one hundred twenty dollars every three years', via Justia) and the Passport to the Parks change describing '$24 during the customary 3-year registration'.

cleanAirActFee.note: EVs exempt per the fee page.

greenhouseGasFee.unit: per new registration with certificate of origin (new car)
greenhouseGasFee.note: $7.50 when registering with an existing title (used car).

passportToParksFee.note: Was $15 before 2025-07-01. EVs exempt per the fee page extraction.

emissionsExemptionFee.unit: one-time, vehicles four model years old or newer

newPassengerRegistrationTotal.note: DMV states 'Registration fee: $190' for a personal car; arithmetic 120+25 title+5 plate+10 admin+15 clean air+15 parks = 190 (matches the pre-July-2025 $15 parks fee; the page may not be updated for the $24). Excludes emissions exemption, greenhouse gas, lien and sales tax.

salesTaxStatewideBaseRate.note: Use tax at the same rate is collected by DMV on private-party purchases.

salesTaxLosAngelesCity.note: CDTFA Special Notice L-1037 (Aug 2026): County of Los Angeles countywide rate 9.750% -> 10.250% effective 2026-10-01. City of Los Angeles is not in the by-city list, so it takes the countywide rate.

salesTaxLosAngelesCityFromOct2026.note: Countywide change; many other LA County cities go to 10.75-11.25%.

salesTaxSanFrancisco.note: 7.25% state + 1.375% district. Not in L-1037 changes. Not confirmed on a CDTFA page this session.

vehicleLicenseFeeRate.unit: fraction of purchase price/value, per year
vehicleLicenseFeeRate.note: Value depreciates by statutory schedule in later years (schedule not captured).

countyDistrictFees.note: DMV says 'varies by county'; no per-county amounts captured.

vatIncludedInPrice.unit: fraction, included in the retail price
vatIncludedInPrice.note: Standard rate; not re-fetched this session. No separate purchase tax is paid by the buyer.

vedFirstYearRatesByCO2.unit: first year (first tax payment), cars registered on or after 2017-04-01
vedFirstYearRatesByCO2.note: Rates as on GOV.UK when fetched 2026-09-29. The page shows no effective date; they are higher than the 2025/26 table (e.g. 111-130g £440, >255g £5,490), so they are taken to be the April 2026 uprating. Petrol, RDE2 diesel, alternative fuel and zero-emission. Non-RDE2 diesel pays one band higher (1-50g £135 ... 226-255g and >255g £5,690).

vedStandardRate.unit: per year, single 12-month payment (from second tax payment)
vedStandardRate.note: £210 total if paid by 12 monthly Direct Debits. Applies to petrol, diesel, alternative fuel and electric cars registered from 2017-04-01.

expensiveCarSupplement.unit: per year, years 2-6 of the car's life

expensiveCarSupplementThresholdICE.unit: list price above which the supplement applies

expensiveCarSupplementThresholdEV.unit: list price above which the supplement applies to electric cars
expensiveCarSupplementThresholdEV.period: current; GOV.UK says it also applies to EVs registered 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31
expensiveCarSupplementThresholdEV.note: Zero-emission vehicles registered before 2025-04-01 do not pay the supplement.

evTreatment.value: EVs pay the lowest first-year rate (£10, 0g/km) then the standard rate (£200), plus the expensive car supplement over £50,000 list price

vrtCO2RatesCategoryA.unit: fraction of Open Market Selling Price (OMSP), or the minimum, whichever is greater; WLTP g/km bands (each band is 'more than' the previous maxG up to and including maxG)

noxLevy.unit: per mg/km NOx, marginal bands, added to CO2 charge
noxLevy.note: Where satisfactory NOx evidence is unavailable: €4,850 for diesel, €600 for others. Pure EVs exempt; hybrids pay.

evVrtRelief.note: Full relief up to €5,000 for OMSP up to €40,000; reduced relief for OMSP over €40,000 and under €50,000; no relief above €50,000. Budget 2026 extended it to end-2026. Taper formula (secondary sources: relief reduced by 50% of OMSP over €40,000) not confirmed on Revenue's page.

motorTaxWLTPBands2021On.unit: per year, private cars first registered on/after 2021-01-01
motorTaxWLTPBands2021On.period: effective 2021-01-01; unchanged for 2026 per secondary sources on Budget 2026
motorTaxWLTPBands2021On.note: Rates €120-€600 read from the Department of Transport PDF; the 191-200 (€790), 201-225 (€1,250) and 226+ (€2,400) rows came from a search summary citing motortax.ie and did not extract cleanly from the PDF. Half-year = 55.5% and quarterly = 28.25% of annual per the PDF.

budget2026MotorTaxChange.note: No motor tax rate change found; could not fetch Citizens Information (HTTP 403).

hstRate.unit: fraction of purchase price (dealer / GST-HST registrant sales)
hstRate.period: since 2016-10-01; listed for on or after 2025-04-01

privateSaleRST.unit: fraction of the greater of purchase price or wholesale value (Canadian Red Book)
privateSaleRST.note: Paid by buyer at ServiceOntario on registration; not paid to the seller. Exempt on gifts to close family members.

plateWithPermitFee.unit: one-time, new or replacement plate with permit

plateRenewalFee.note: Ontario eliminated licence plate sticker renewal fees for passenger vehicles and light trucks effective 2022-03-13 (previously $120/yr southern, $60/yr northern). Renewal itself is still required. Not confirmed on an ontario.ca page this session.

usedVehicleInformationPackageFee.note: Required for private sales; fee not stated on the pages fetched.

gstRate.period: current, listed for on or after 2025-04-01
gstRate.note: No GST on private sales between individuals.

pstPassengerFromDealer.unit: fraction of the entire purchase price, passenger vehicles bought from a GST registrant, imported or leased

pstPassengerPrivateSale.unit: fraction of purchase price (private sale or taxable gift)
pstPassengerPrivateSale.note: Tax base on private sales can be the greater of price and a value measure (average wholesale / appraisal); rules not captured in full.

pstZEVFromDealer.unit: fraction of purchase price, ZEVs acquired after 2022-02-22
pstZEVFromDealer.note: Private sale ZEV rates: 12% below $125,000, then 15%/20%. Used-ZEV PST exemption ran 2022-02-23 to 2025-04-30.

registrationFee.period: Motor Vehicle Fees Regulation, consolidated to 2026-09-22

annualLicenceFeeByNetWeight.note: Read via a summarizing fetch; the lower rows (all $46 up to 1,000 kg) should be re-checked against the regulation text. Paid with ICBC Autoplan insurance.

iva.note: General IVA rate (LIVA art. 1); not re-fetched this session. Included in dealer prices; ISAN exemption thresholds exclude IVA, tenencia subsidy threshold includes it.

isanTariff2026.unit: fixed fee + rate on excess over lower limit; price before IVA
isanTariff2026.note: If price exceeds $1,060,189.93, the tax is reduced by 7% of the difference between the price and $1,060,189.93.

isanFullExemptionThreshold2026.unit: price excluding IVA at or below which no ISAN
isanFullExemptionThreshold2026.note: LFISAN art. 8 fr. II, amount updated by RMF DOF 2025-12-28. 50% exemption for prices $356,934.06 to $452,116.48.

isanEVExemption.note: Art. 8 fr. IV: battery-electric cars, and electric cars that also have a combustion or hydrogen engine (hybrids), are exempt.

tenenciaSubsidyThreshold2026.unit: vehicle value incl. IVA at or below which the 100% tenencia subsidy applies
tenenciaSubsidyThreshold2026.note: Condition: pay the refrendo on time and owe no prior tenencia. Deadline originally 2026-03-31, extended to 2026-06-30 (El Financiero, 2026-04-28). Motorcycles: $250,000.

tenenciaTariffAboveThreshold.note: Código Fiscal CDMX tenencia tariff for vehicles above the subsidy threshold not captured.

refrendo2026.note: Código Fiscal CDMX art. 219 fr. I a). 50% reduction for electric vehicles and vehicles adapted for people with disabilities.

altaDePlacas2026.unit: one-time: initial plates, tarjeta de circulación and calcomanía
altaDePlacas2026.note: Art. 219 fr. I b). 50% reduction for EVs. A secondary report of $804 for new cars was not borne out by the Tesorería table.

tarjetaCirculacion2026.note: Art. 219 fr. IV; column alignment in the PDF extraction was imperfect, and El Universal reports the same $433.

cambioDePropietario2026.unit: change of owner incl. new tarjeta de circulación
cambioDePropietario2026.note: Art. 219 fr. V; read from a column-misaligned PDF extraction — re-check.

commercialBankNewCar60moAPR.note: G.19 release of 2026-09-08. Unweighted average of each bank's most common rate in the first week of the quarter's middle month. Also FRED series RIFLPBCIANM60NM. 2026 Q1 was 7.53.

_source.period: 2026 Q2 (State of the Automotive Finance Market; page dated 2026-09-10)

shareOfPrivateNewCarsFinancedByFLAMember.note: FLA is an industry body. Wording: 'finance for over 85% of private new car registrations'. Published 2026-06-17. Treat 85 as a floor, not a point value.

motorFinanceLentH1.note: FLA data reported by Car Dealer Magazine, 2026-08-06.

typicalPCPorHPAPR.note: No regulator, central bank or FLA average car-finance APR found. Bank of England effective rates cover 'other loans' to individuals, not car finance. Broker representative APRs (e.g. 9.9%) are adverts, not market averages.

newConsumerLoanRate.unit: percent, weighted average on new consumer loan agreements
newConsumerLoanRate.note: All consumer lending, not car loans specifically. Down 76bp on June. Floating 7.90% (59% of volume), fixed 5.05%. New volume EUR 364m.

carFinanceSpecificRate.note: Not published separately by the Central Bank of Ireland.

charteredBankAutoLoanRateNewLending.note: Bank of Canada series V122667805 ('Personal loan plans: of which auto loans', funds advanced by chartered banks); also Statistics Canada table 10-10-0006-01. New and used combined; excludes captive finance companies and credit unions.

sourceType convention: "primary" is used for manufacturer sites and documents and for the official registration bodies (SMMT for GB, SIMI Motorstats for IE). Both bodies are industry organisations rather than government; they count as primary here only because they are the recognised registration-statistics publishers.
GB sales: SMMT figures cover UK registrations (GB and Northern Ireland combined). SMMT publishes no GB-only model ranking.

IE sales: SIMI's press release of 2 Jan 2026 ranks the top 5 as Tucson, Octavia, Sportage, Yaris Cross, RAV4 but gives no unit counts. The live SIMI Motorstats database, queried 2026-09-29 for calendar 2025, puts Yaris Cross 3rd (3,580) and Sportage 4th (3,463), and its 2025 total is 124,969 against the 124,954 published, so it appears to include late revisions. The catalog uses the database counts and order. Ranks 9-10 in the database: Hyundai Kona 2,597, VW Golf 2,437.
IE sales: secondary figures conflict with SIMI and were not used (changinglanes.ie gives Tucson 4,313; AIG's Tucson 4,276 is January-October CSO data only).

GB Kia Sportage: Kia UK publishes only 7.1 l/100km for the Pure manual. No mpg is published (a conversion gives about 39.8), so economy is null. Kia's CO2 conflicts: the pricing page says 158 g/km and the spec page 162; 158 was used. No kerb weight.
GB Nissan Qashqai: no mpg is published for the manual. The brochure gives 6.3-6.4 l/100km, so economy is null.

GB Vauxhall Corsa: vauxhall.co.uk returned 403, so the price and CO2 are secondary (carwow). No mpg is confirmed for the 100PS manual, the 121 g/km is not tied explicitly to the Yes trim, and no kerb weight was found.

GB VW Golf: the manufacturer price is JS-rendered and could not be read, so price, mpg and CO2 are secondary (carwow). What Car? gives 53.3 mpg and 120 g/km for the same version, which conflicts. It is also not confirmed that the 1.5 TSI 115 Life is the current UK entry version. No kerb weight.

GB Volvo XC40: volvocars.com/uk returned 403, so all figures are secondary (carwow). Indexed Volvo UK build pages showed £33,860 for a Core B3 in May 2026, which may reflect a price change or options. No kerb weight.

GB MG HS: MG's 38.1 mpg is an "up to" figure. The CO2 of 168 g/km and kerb weight of 1,550 kg are secondary (automobile-catalog.com, seen through a search summary). Some dealers still quote £26,495, but the manufacturer's live £27,495 is used.
GB Ford Puma: the kerb weight is a range-wide "from" figure. The web page says CO2 "from 121 g/km", and the price list gives 122 for this trim; 122 was used.
GB Nissan Juke: it is unclear whether the 1,199 kg kerb weight includes a driver.
IE Hyundai Tucson: the diesel's WLTP l/100km is not published on hyundai.ie (the feed gives CO2 141 only), so economy is null. The engine size and power are not stated. No kerb weight.

IE Toyota Yaris Cross: the €33,155 from-price is not labelled with a grade on the page. It is attributed to Luna, the only Hybrid 115 entry grade in the July 2026 guide. The specs are marked "pending final homologation". No kerb weight.

IE Kia Sportage: the page contradicts itself (menu €41,300, powertrain block €41,000). The trim name is not shown, and economy and CO2 are the lower ends of published ranges (5.1-5.4 l/100km, 132-141 g/km). No kerb weight.

IE Toyota RAV4: the headline "From €47,340" (labelled "RAV4 Hybrid Sol" in a finance example) could not be tied to a listed grade. A self-charging HEV Sol may exist below the PHEV Sol used here. No kerb weight.

IE Skoda Kodiaq: the PHEV economy and CO2 are the low ends of ranges (1.6-1.7 l/100km, 36-37 g/km). The model page shows a different from-price (€56,330, TDI) and "Selection from €53,670", which conflict with the September 2026 guide. No kerb weight.
IE Skoda Octavia and VW Tiguan: the weights include a 75 kg driver (EU unladen minimum), not a driverless kerb weight, and both were read from misaligned PDF text extractions.
IE Toyota Corolla: SIMI counts all Corolla bodies (hatch, Touring Sports, saloon) together. The price and specs are for the hatchback. No kerb weight.
